recovered_from.artifact: WD-038 Maker Cart Procurement and Price Registry
retained: procurement is an adapter from capability gaps, not a standalone project

changes: created public local-only Shopping Field under FCM
added conservative import of legacy House OS shopping v0.4 exports
mapped legacy CONFIRMED to VERIFY with a migration note rather than assuming ownership/adoption
added listing freshness and explicit source class
added landed-SGD component calculator and quantity-normalized unit cost
preserved six-part purchase gate and bounded research-agent packet
kept personal inventory out of public seed; imported state stays browser-local
Added explicit selected-item → Dayline task handoff using next_action (or a bounded resolve fallback) with item id/state, freshness, gate and adoption evidence.
Research/purchase truth states remain unchanged; no handoff can purchase, message a seller or promote ownership.
Transport is session-local atlas-dayline-handoff/v0.1 and requires explicit ADD TO DAY.
Added explicit ESSENTIAL / CAPABILITY / EXPEDITION lanes so realistic procurement and playful market exploration share one adapter without becoming one backlog.
Lane is browser-local, filterable, exported, included in research packets and explicit Dayline handoffs; EXPEDITION denotes curiosity/research rather than purchase authority.
Added optional BODY W/D/H, OPERATING W/D/H and mass fields so physical envelope is first-class alongside landed cost.
Added SERVICE / MAINTENANCE and DEPENDENCIES / CONSUMABLES / LOCK-IN burden fields without creating a second item store.
Added explicit selected-item → canonical HOUSE FIT handoff using session-only house-shopping-fit/v0.1; Shopping retains candidate/ownership authority.
DAYLINE and HOUSE returns preserve the exact selected Shopping item through its hash address.
Agent research packets include fit, burden and placement-home evidence.
Consumes exact Shopping-addressed atlas-dayline-source-return/v0.1 offers after Dayline RUN → WITNESS → COMPLETE → RETURN.
Shopping revalidates source route + exact item id/address + original lifecycle state before enabling receipt acceptance.
Accepted Dayline result is stored as browser-local shopping-dayline-receipt/v0.1 evidence only; purchase/adoption lifecycle and next_action remain unchanged.
Stale, wrong-item, incomplete-task or non-RECEIPT_ONLY offers are read-only/dismissible.
Added derived per-item evidence signal (CLEAR / CHANGED / REALITY / EXTERNAL / MIXED) using shared FIELD semantic patterns; projection never mutates lifecycle.
Selected item exposes a collapsed evidence/reality bar with proof boundary + smallest next proof; list items carry the same recognition pattern.
Agent research packets include evidence_signal, proof_boundary and next_proof.
